summary: Speed display for unknown-total tasks is implemented in rich/progress.py, with a CHANGELOG entry and test updates. Nothing was run (tests, scripts, or installs) per the instructions, so all verification was by reading only. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off) and a classmethod render_speed that formats speed via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix; render() returns speed text when total is None and show_speed is on. The track() helper gained a last parameter show_speed (default True) passed to the column. Progress.track now sets the total to the explicit value, else len() for Sized sequences, else None, instead of raising. CHANGELOG.md has a new Added line. In tests/test_progress.py, the two ValueError assertions were removed and test_task_progress_column_speed was added. Nothing was committed. One unspecified case: for an existing task_id, update() ignores a None total, so that task's total is left unchanged.
